description: Lists the details of the organization and account instances of IAM Identity Center that were created in or visible to the account calling this API.

incidents.description: NATS-as-C2: Inside a new technique attackers are using to harvest cloud credentials and AI API keys

securityImplications: Attackers might use ListInstances to enumerate the IAM Identity Center instances in an account, mapping its single sign-on footprint as part of reconnaissance with a stolen key.
